description: Source code for a BPF (Berkeley Packet Filter) module implementation, including functions for managing BPF maps, programs, modules, and debugging handlers, with integration into a custom VM environment.

classes.name: uc_bpf_fd
classes.description: Structure representing a file descriptor with a close flag.

classes.name: uc_bpf_map
classes.description: Structure representing a BPF map with associated resource and key/value sizes.

classes.name: uc_bpf_map_iter
classes.description: Iterator structure for traversing BPF map keys.

methods.name: set_error
methods.description: Sets the last error message and code, with formatted message support.

methods.name: init_env
methods.description: Initializes environment limits for BPF operations.

methods.name: uc_bpf_error
methods.description: Returns the last error message or code in the VM environment.

methods.name: uc_bpf_module_set_opts
methods.description: Configures BPF module options such as rodata and program types.

methods.name: uc_bpf_open_module
methods.description: Opens and loads a BPF module from a file path with optional settings.

methods.name: uc_bpf_map_create
methods.description: Creates a new BPF map resource.

methods.name: uc_bpf_open_map
methods.description: Opens an existing BPF map by file path.

methods.name: uc_bpf_open_program
methods.description: Opens a BPF program by file path.

methods.name: uc_bpf_module_get_maps
methods.description: Retrieves list of map names in a BPF module.

methods.name: uc_bpf_module_get_map
methods.description: Retrieves a specific map resource by name.

methods.name: uc_bpf_module_get_programs
methods.description: Retrieves list of program names in a BPF module.

methods.name: uc_bpf_module_get_program
methods.description: Retrieves a specific program resource by name.

methods.name: uc_bpf_map_get
methods.description: Gets an element from a BPF map by key.

methods.name: uc_bpf_map_set
methods.description: Sets an element in a BPF map.

methods.name: uc_bpf_map_delete
methods.description: Deletes an element from a BPF map.

methods.name: uc_bpf_map_delete_all
methods.description: Deletes all elements from a BPF map, optionally filtered by a callable.

methods.name: uc_bpf_map_iterator
methods.description: Creates an iterator for BPF map keys.

methods.name: uc_bpf_map_iter_next
methods.description: Returns the next key in the BPF map iterator.

methods.name: uc_bpf_map_iter_next_int
methods.description: Returns the next key as an integer in the BPF map iterator.

methods.name: uc_bpf_map_foreach
methods.description: Iterates over all map entries, calling a provided function.

methods.name: uc_bpf_obj_pin
methods.description: Pins a BPF object to a filesystem path.

methods.name: uc_bpf_program_pin
methods.description: Pins a BPF program to a filesystem path.

methods.name: uc_bpf_map_pin
methods.description: Pins a BPF map to a filesystem path.

methods.name: uc_bpf_set_tc_hook
methods.description: Sets up a traffic control hook for a network interface.

methods.name: uc_bpf_program_tc_attach
methods.description: Attaches a BPF program to a traffic control hook.

methods.name: uc_bpf_tc_detach
methods.description: Detaches a BPF program from a traffic control hook.

methods.name: uc_bpf_debug_print
methods.description: Custom print function for libbpf debug output, forwarding to VM handler.

methods.name: uc_bpf_set_debug_handler
methods.description: Sets a debug handler callback for BPF debugging.

methods.name: register_constants
methods.description: Registers BPF related constants in the VM scope.

methods.name: uc_module_init
methods.description: Initializes the BPF module, registering functions and constants.
